title: OcEx
description: Website for a company that provides independent expert assessments, damage appraisal and risk analysis.
infotext: Designed in Figma, built on Next.js, content managed in Directus.
company: OcEx is an independent expert assessment agency specialising in damage appraisal, risk analysis and insurance claim reviews. It works nationwide, providing accurate and prompt solutions for insurers, businesses and private clients.
problem: The new website and logo had to meet modern standards and, just as importantly, convey the company's professionalism. Special attention went to usability and a stylish design that leaves a strong impression and makes the site comfortable to use.
mockups_description: The project had a fixed set of required information, but full stylistic freedom, which left room for a creative approach. I studied the company's field in depth and developed several logo and visual identity concepts. The result is a modern website design that reflects the company's work and highlights what sets it apart.
result: The result is a memorable website that clearly presents every area of the company's work, highlights its strengths and makes information easy to find. The new identity helps OcEx stand out from competitors and build effective relationships with clients.
meta_title: Case study: website and logo for OcEx
meta_description: Website for OcEx, a company that provides independent expert assessments, damage appraisal and risk analysis.
